[FACT] User is planning a photography trip.

[EVENT] User recently took a road trip to Big Sur with friends.

[PREFERENCE] User is interested in capturing stunning coastal scenery.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided general tips and camera settings for capturing coastal scenery, including shooting in RAW, using a low ISO (100-400), and a wide aperture (f/2.8 or lower).

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended a slower shutter speed (around 1/30s to 1/15s) to create a sense of movement in waves and clouds.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested setting white balance to "Cloudy" or "Shade" to enhance warm tones.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided composition tips, including looking for interesting foreground elements, playing with leading lines, capturing during the golden hour, experimenting with different angles, and paying attention to the sky.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended bringing a polarizing filter, shooting in burst mode, being prepared for changing weather, and respecting the environment.

[PREFERENCE] User had amazing sunset views at Bixby Bridge on their way to Monterey.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided sunset photography tips, including planning ahead, scouting locations, using a tripod, shooting in RAW, and bracketing shots.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended capturing the blue hour, using a graduated neutral density filter, experimenting with shutter speed, taking multiple shots, and staying safe.
